title: Quick Buffalo Chicken Tacos
reject_reason: Chicken breast + buffalo sauce in tortillas with blue cheese is the same buffalo-chicken-in-tortilla dinner as live buffalo-chicken-burrito; taco vs burrito is not a distinguishing plate and the buffalo-chicken lane is already carried three ways.
